feature.title: Recover a Kernel passkey account with a wallet

notes: RESR-21 owns the research result. PRD-1447 tracks deferred Product delivery.
Fork proof is historical research evidence; implementation lanes require their own receipts.
Confirm eligible cohorts, guardian delay, and Arbitrum finality before production enrollment.

2026-11-21: Afo chose design, fork proofs and PRs for this plan. The contracts lane has a recovery executor with unit and fork proof on a PR; no merge, deployment or broadcast is authorized. The hub stays in backlog until the delay, cohort and confirmation policies are set.

2026-11-21: Afo decided the recovered-account record (chain is the authority, directory keeps a re-checked pointer) and the delay (any delay at enrollment, 48 hours by default in the app, cancellable by the current passkey). The eligible cohort and the Arbitrum confirmation rule stay open.

tdd.note: The executor was written before its tests, so no failing-first run was recorded. Fallback proof: the unit suite and the Arbitrum fork suite at the tested commit.
